title: Even wider search
items: The search bar now takes all the spare room in the top bar (up to about twice its old size), with just a sliver left to drag the window

title: Wider search
items: The search bar grows to fill the empty space in the top bar (up to a comfortable width), leaving a little room to drag the window

title: Deals, guides, recaps and more
items: Price tracker: wishlist games show their lowest-ever Steam price, with a Lowest price ever tag when it's that low now. Store pages show the lowest price anywhere, cheaper stores right now, and a chart of prices Cinder has seen
Price alerts: click the bell on a wishlist game (or set it on its store page) and get a notification when it drops to your price
How long to beat: main story, extras and completionist times from HowLongToBeat on game pages and store pages, with how far your play time gets you

Achievement help: hidden achievements show their description blurred (click to reveal), Tips under each locked achievement pull the matching part of top Steam guides, and guides open in a reader right in Cinder
Session recap: when you close a game, a card shows how long you played, achievements you unlocked and your new total (turn it off in Settings → Account)
Recommendations: Because you played … rows on the Store tab, built from the games you play most

title: Reviewer profiles in Cinder
items: Fixed: every reviewer showed the same picture (Steam's thumbs-up icon) instead of their own avatar
Clicking a reviewer now opens their profile right in Cinder instead of Steam

title: See who wrote each review
items: Reviews show the reviewer's Steam name, profile picture and how many games they own
Click a reviewer to open their Steam profile in Steam

title: Reviews show up
items: Fixed: the Reviews tab said "No reviews here yet" because Steam's review cards are laid out slightly differently than expected

title: Steam reviews from the Community hub
items: Reviews now load from the game's Steam Community page (the same reviews Steam shows), since Steam's review service sends Cinder its home page instead
Most helpful, Recent, Positive and Negative, with hours played, posted date and helpful/funny votes

title: Steam reviews, take three
items: Steam's firewall turns away reviews requests that don't come from a real browser. Cinder now fetches them through a hidden browser window (the same engine its own window uses), which closes itself after a minute

title: Steam reviews, take two
items: The overall Steam rating (like Mostly Positive) now comes from Steam's store service, the same one Cinder already uses for game names and art
Reviews: when Steam answers with its home page instead of reviews, Cinder asks again a different way, then through your Steam client if it's connected
If reviews still can't load, a Read them in Steam button opens the game's reviews in Steam

title: Reviews fixed, specs, edge-to-edge couch mode
items: Fixed: reviews and the Steam rating failed to load ("Steam sent something unexpected")
The overall Steam rating (like Mostly Positive) now shows right under the game's name on game pages and store pages, and in couch mode
New Specs tab on game pages and a System requirements section on store pages: minimum and recommended
Couch mode: true full screen with no thin border (Windows 11's window outline and rounded corners are switched off while it's open)

title: Steam reviews
items: Steam review scores (like "Very Positive · 91% of 45,123") on game pages and store pages
A Reviews tab on game pages and a Reviews section on store pages: most helpful, recent, positive or negative, with hours played and helpful votes; load more as you scroll
Couch mode now fills the screen edge to edge, with no thin border around it

title: Couch mode, Stats, Storage and more
items: Couch mode: a full-screen, controller-friendly view with your games as retro game cases. Open it with the controller button in the top bar, F11, or your controller's Start button; B or Esc leaves
Stats tab: hours this week and month, a 30-day chart, streaks, most played, play by weekday and time of day, recent sessions
Storage tab: every drive with what games take up, biggest and unplayed games, move a game to another drive, uninstall
Rate games 1–5 stars, set a status (Playing, Backlog, Beaten, 100%, Dropped) and keep notes on each game page; filter and sort by them
Edit a game's Steam launch options from its game page
Library redraws are now about 10× faster again on big libraries

title: Smoother and lighter
items: Library redraws about 3–4× faster on big libraries; searching, filtering and favoriting no longer rebuild every cover
Covers don't fade in again when the library refreshes, and the page doesn't jump while scrolling
Coming back to Cinder no longer reloads everything twice; Downloads and achievement checks pause while Cinder is hidden
Steam's large settings file is re-read in the background instead of holding things up
Cover art never stalls the app while art lookups run
Fixes: workshop browse could get stuck loading, store pages could show stale results, friends list no longer flashes, settings saved quickly in a row no longer undo each other
Security: Cinder only answers requests made to your own PC

title: What's new
items: New What's new button in the top bar: every Cinder update in one place, with a dot when there's something you haven't seen

title: Download speed in Mbps
items: Show download speed in MB/s, Mbps or both: click the speed on the Downloads tab, or pick in Settings → Appearance
Speeds show one decimal place

title: Only run Steam when needed
items: New setting (Settings → Steam): Steam stays closed while you browse in Cinder and starts in the background when you play, update or change status
Closes Steam after a few idle minutes: no game running, nothing downloading, no Steam window open
Steam status shows whether it's closed, running, or about to close

title: Workshop on game pages
items: Games with a Steam Workshop get a Workshop button and tab on their game page, with your item count and updates
Store pages get a Workshop button for games that have one

title: Library layouts
items: Switch the library between Covers, Banners, Tiles, List and Shelves
Cover-size slider right in the library header
List view with sortable columns: play time, last played, achievements, size
New sort: Achievements

title: Steam Workshop
items: Workshop tab: your mods per game, size on disk and updates waiting
Browse any game's workshop: trending, popular, top rated, newest, search
Item pages with preview, stats and description; subscribe in Steam, open folder, update

title: Updates that start
items: Update buttons now call Steam the same way Steam's own Update button does
Cinder checks Steam's download log to confirm an update really started

title: Downloads tab
items: Full Downloads tab: live progress, speed graph, time left, queue, finished list
Start now, pause, resume, remove, Pause all / Resume all
Updates available list with Update all

title: Update without launching
items: Update button on covers, game pages, the right-click menu and Downloads
Downloads badge counts updates waiting

title: Achievements on covers
items: Trophy badge and progress bar on covers while viewing a list (gold at 100%)
Game card options: what shows under covers, play time and date formats, two-line names, hide ™/®

title: Achievements, lists and profile
items: Achievements tab across all your games: recent, rarest, almost done
Game lists: your Steam collections plus Cinder lists
Customize your Cinder profile, with Edit on Steam shortcuts

title: Game pages and alerts
items: Game page tabs for achievements, news and DLC
Non-Steam games show up and launch
Wishlist sale alerts

title: While you play
items: Now playing pill with a session timer; Cinder tucks away while you play
Downloads panel, favorites, hidden games and Pick for me

title: Instant start
items: Installed version that opens instantly, with Start menu and Desktop shortcuts
Lives in the tray and can start with Windows

title: Status and quiet launching
items: Set your status: Online, Away, Invisible, Offline (checked against what friends see)
Games launch without Steam's window or its Starting game popup

title: Faster, with art for every game
items: Art for every game from Steam's newer image cache
Collapsible icon-only sidebar
Scrollbars match your theme; click and drag to scroll rows

title: Tabs like Steam
items: Store, Wishlist, Friends and Profile tabs
Quick style options on top of any theme
Drag the window to the top of the screen to maximize; snap to the sides

title: Built-in updaters
items: Cinder updates itself from GitHub releases
Update Steam on demand while it otherwise stays frozen

title: Cinder
items: A fast, themeable front end for your Steam library
Keeps Steam on its current build so Steamidra keeps working
